reasoning: This workout targets your lactate clearance limiter by utilizing extended sweet spot work following a back-to-back Zone 2 effort. Your last ride showed recovery with a moderate intensity session, so now it's effective to push in the sweet spot range. This session directly prepares you for the Alpine Loop climb, particularly the Sundance to Cascade Springs segment, to develop your endurance for sustained efforts.

suggested_sets.name: Main Set
suggested_sets.description: Start with 10 minutes at 209W in Zone 2, then transition to alternating 7-minute efforts at 209-223W and 4-minute surges to 242-256W to challenge lactate clearance.
